implementation: Standalone offline healthcare identity/scoped-query diagnostic for Windows launcher and Python module.

entry_points.configuration: JOHNY_SKORE_HEALTHCARE_IDENTITIES_FILE is used and recorded in report.inputs; otherwise default manifest.

read_only_contract.database_access: Existing diagnostic service uses SQLite URI mode=ro plus query_only=ON. CLI supplies a db_path handle without constructing ScoutStore.

protected: all production data registries/canonical input/profile catalogue
hardlink/symlink aliases and symlink parent directories

meaningful_cases: Absent database not created and ScoutStore initialization explicitly forbidden
Configured manifest content hash and input path reported
Existing DB contents unchanged; same collector scope check counted
Malformed/naive/oversized times rejected before filesystem mutations; timezone offsets identical
Bounded paths, web URLs and non-JSON outputs rejected
DB/custom registry/production files protected including hardlinks/symlinks/directory aliases
Existing report preserved and temp files removed on serialization/replace failure
Missing manifest saved as an explicit gap with no invented identity
Real Python module subprocess from a directory containing spaces; report parsed and DB stayed absent
Windows BAT references offline module and venv fallback; no app or collector invocation

blockers: Launcher was inspected and CLI was executed on Linux; no actual user Windows execution is claimed.
Broader dated healthcare identities, source-wide positive/negative live cases and historical evaluation remain outstanding.
The report only diagnoses saved evidence; it does not collect missing identity or source data.
